applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: GL audit basis entered without supporting data or in the wrong unit for the class
symptoms: Sales or payroll keyed on a class rated on a different basis
Zero basis on a class that is not 'if any'
cause: Missing validation rules: basis must match the class's basis type and unit; payroll requires an employee count.
diagnosis: Review the basis entry per exposure with the auditor or user
resolution: Correct the data with the auditor or user and re-rate
permanent_fix: Validation rules: basis matches class basis type; payroll requires employee count (T0105); warning on zero basis.
escalation: PC L3 Rating & Audit for the rule change.
